Gestion des Identités Privilégiées

A security discipline and toolset focused on discovering, controlling, and monitoring accounts with elevated access rights, ensuring least privilege, and detecting misuse or anomalies.

Questions and answers

What is Gestion des Identités Privilégiées?

In this glossary, Gestion des Identités Privilégiées refers to: A security discipline and toolset focused on discovering, controlling, and monitoring accounts with elevated access rights, ensuring least privilege, and detecting misuse or anomalies.

How is Gestion des Identités Privilégiées used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Activez la gestion des identités privilégiées pour appliquer l’accès juste-à-temps et surveiller toutes les activités des comptes privilégiés en cas d’utilisation abusive."

Definition

A security discipline and toolset focused on discovering, controlling, and monitoring accounts with elevated access rights, ensuring least privilege, and detecting misuse or anomalies.

Operational example

Enable privileged identity management to enforce just-in-time access and monitor all privileged account activities for signs of misuse.
